analysis_status: Descriptive recount of legacy CSV labels; not an adjudicated claim-precision study
method_limitations: Each row is an information item for one agent, not necessarily one atomic factual claim.
The CSV uses prose outcomes for some sites and PASS/FAIL codes for others.
Tool exposure fields refer to different tool scopes and cannot be pooled as a single four-stage recall metric.
Unstated/absent items should not be counted as human-visible positive facts.
No independent claim-to-evidence adjudication is performed by this script.

stock_affordance.note: Six item IDs duplicate three page-level stock assertions across two agents. The pilot reports six agent answers asserting stock without an explicit stock statement; physical stock is unknown.

absence_to_negation.note: Four agent-item rows describe categorical incompatibility claims from missing selector options. Physical compatibility is unknown.

known_scoring_conflicts: BD2-20: three arms report Fresh from an asset filename where the site audit identifies MGI; the CSV gap field says None.
BD-TR03-04/05: exact promo codes differ in one PASS-labeled arm.
BD-ED01-17/19 and BD-GV01-07/08: PASS labels coexist with different numbers, names, or OCR text in site tables.
